format: C# ASP.NET Core Razor Page Model
description: This file defines the server-side code-behind class for the 'Checkout' page in a Razor Pages application, managing basket checkout operations, user authentication, and order creation.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: PageModel for managing the checkout process, including basket retrieval, order creation, and user identification.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to prepare the checkout page.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the checkout, update basket quantities, create order, and handle exceptions.

methods.name: SetBasketModelAsync
methods.description: Ensures basket information is loaded for the current user or anonymous via cookie.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Assigns or retrieves the user's basket identifier via cookies or generates a new GUID.
